items.title: ELEVATE NxT 2026–27 (DeepTech)
items.shortDesc: Karnataka's milestone-based grant-in-aid for deep-tech startups. Open to eligible startups from anywhere in India; winners are expected to move their registered office to Karnataka.
items.about: Karnataka's milestone-based grant-in-aid for deep-tech startups. Open to eligible startups from anywhere in India; winners are expected to move their registered office to Karnataka. Closes 5:00 PM IST on 13 Nov 2026.
items.eligibility:
Deep-tech startup as per DPIIT definition (up to 20 years old, turnover up to ₹300 Cr)
No ELEVATE grant received in the 3 years before 13 Oct 2026
Must relocate registered office to Karnataka if selected
items.benefits:
One-time equity-free grant up to ₹1 Cr in milestones
Mentoring and incubation support

items.title: ELEVATE Minorities 2026

items.about: Grant-in-aid for Karnataka-registered startups where a founder from a minority community holds at least 51% equity. Closes 5:00 PM IST on 13 Nov 2026. Applicants need at least 60 marks to reach the final pitch.
items.eligibility:
Startup registered in Karnataka
At least 51% equity held by a minority-community founder
DPIIT recognition not required per the 2026 call
items.benefits:
One-time grant up to ₹50 lakh
Mentoring support

Early-stage Indian startups
Solution must fit one of the published track problem statements
items.benefits:
Share of ₹1 Cr prize pool
Month of mentorship (Dec 2026)
Real deployment and investor visibility

Organisations with insurance / risk-protection solutions for Indian MSMEs

Access to UNDP and Generali expertise

Legally registered private-sector organisations
Implementation-ready innovation
Preference for women-led and youth-led ventures; priority countries are Bangladesh, Indonesia, Philippines, Thailand and Viet Nam — check India eligibility in the call
items.benefits:
Up to USD 100,000 via deliverable-based contract
Up to 17 months of incubation and mentoring
